summary: Ran a fresh isolated headless Google Chrome session against https://autopilot.local/katalogi/ without submitting forms, sending messages, placing orders or invoking payments. The route returned HTTP 200 with one catalogue section, two cards and four visible action labels. The session reported zero page errors, console errors and failed requests. All four labels are SPAN elements with no href, no download attribute and tabIndex=-1, so the section contains zero actionable controls and download/navigation behavior cannot be exercised without genuine destinations.
issues: INT-CAT-001 (blocked) — property: catalogue download and online-reader actions. Expected: source-backed PDF attachments and approved online-reader destinations supporting four testable native actions. Actual: source nodes 349:1253, 349:1255, 431:933 and 431:938 have null hyperlinks and empty reactions; the local source clarification confirms two PDFs and two online-reader destinations are still missing; runtime therefore renders four non-focusable SPAN labels and actionableControlCount=0. Required input/fix: provide the two real PDF files and two approved reader URLs, configure the existing native fields, then retest keyboard focus, download response and navigation in isolation.
